Sunday Gospel The kingship of Christ is not of this world. It is a title that comes to him because of his cross and Resurrection. Through the cross of Christ come the mysterious power of the Father’s love. The Father accepts the work and mission of Christ as the means to eternal life for all who believe in his name, and the authority it has over the world. Christ’s kingship comes because he has conquered sin and death an brought us to glory and promise of heaven. Jesus was never of this world, he always pointed to the heavenly Kingdom and that is something that we do each day when we pray: ‘Thy Kingdom come’. It is a kingdom of truth, justice and peace that certainly will come at the end of time, but today we pray that it will come to our lives everyday. November Masses for deceased relatives and friends. TRÓCAIRE requires volunteers to help deliver school talks during our annual Lent Appeal during February and March 2027! We are particularly interested in hearing from people with public speaking experience, especially retired teachers or those who have worked with young people.

The role involves approx 1-2 short talks per week during the four-month campaign period.
Full training, presentation materials and ongoing support will be provided.
